system.description:
The ancient Toreador art of painting souls lets a character reveal the inner nature of a subject through a work of art. Falsehood cannot be portrayed through Soul Painting, for even the artist does not initially know what the image will reveal. To create the work, the artist must study the subject for a full, uninterrupted hour, looking not only at appearance and carriage but also at the subject's aura, then give herself over to an enthralled creative tempest to complete the piece in a single, uninterrupted sitting (typically ten to twelve hours or more).

The player makes a Static Social Challenge against a difficulty of nine Traits. If successful, the player may spend up to three Social Traits to illustrate qualities in the work (one per Trait spent): a rough gauge of Humanity or Path, Willpower, Self-Control, Conscience, Conviction, Instinct, or Courage. Kindred who know Soul Painting immediately recognize every insight portrayed; a character who lacks the power may need to win a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty equal to the number of qualities imbued, one to four Traits) to decode the portrait. This power costs nine Experience Traits to learn.
